description:
Communities competing for Seedit's /s/cats route. The highest-rated finalized candidate resolves the route. Subscriptions and post links continue to use exact community addresses.

https://github.com/bitsocialnet/lists/blob/master/seedit-directories/seedit-cats-directory.json
rules: Every post must show a real cat; big cats count.
No drawings, cartoons, AI-generated images, sculptures, or plush toys.
No animal cruelty, gore, or jokes about harming cats.
No bots, repetitive comments, flooding, spam, or self-promotion.
